what: M10a step 4's early gate (a go/no-go, not the gate): perf_ab.py label_propagation run, damped, 50k and 500k, 11 rounds at the recorded locks against unpatched LabelPropagation-CUDA@a276a3a on GPU 0 (one exclusive window per case), and one D1 nsys peak at 500k on GPU 1 in a GPU-1 quiet window; the internal targets update[sum] and memory <= 1.03, end_to_end <= 1.10

ad21.what: the cost of O's two-stream transfer/compute overlap lost by the single-stream port (AD21): nsys of both at the damped cases on GPU 1; O's host-to-device copies overlapped its kernels for this long, the most the single stream can give up

end_to_end_diagnosis.what: the 50k end_to_end: the unified library's CUDA modules are loaded with the context (CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER on both sides, AD2): the port's driver and context initialisation take about 30 ms more than the original's (~185-195 ms against 156-166 ms; dyng-compat-dynlp --phases and O's --profile, exclusive windows e2e-diagnosis-*); its generation, setup, batches and outputs are not slower, and both processes' exit costs about 72-77 ms

plugin.what: the LP CUDA objects (the six TUs and the graph's device apply) built for CUDA 13.1's release list 75-real;80-real;86-real;89-real;90-real;100-real;120

50k.what: the A/B readings of dyng-compat-dynlp against LabelPropagation-CUDA@a276a3a (AD2, AD3): update[sum] and end_to_end on damped (gated), in_place reported

port.name: dyng-compat-dynlp
port.time_ms: a pair of CUDA events on the resources' stream around each public label_propagation::update() call (AD2); the host wall time of the call in dyng_times.csv

protocol.lock: perf.lock: declared held by the caller (--no-lock / DYNG_PERF_LOCK_HELD=1)
protocol.order: A/B/A/B: in every round O, then the port, one process each, the same session
protocol.argv: bench/run.sh's: --quiet --noValidate, the graph files and the labels written into a fresh per-round scratch directory on the same filesystem and deleted after the round (--noGraphFiles only at 50m); the port adds --backend cuda
protocol.clocks: the lock the baseline recorded per case and schedule (ADRs 0018, 0021)

clocks.how: ncu --clock-control boost on parity/clock_lock/clock_holder.cu (idle, one kernel) for the whole A/B; the timed programs are not profiled
clocks.check: every busy GPU sample of every accepted round at the locked clocks

guard.rule: damped: the port's per-batch counts, accuracy and label bytes equal the original's and their own first round's; in_place: the components

monitor.rule: a pair is repeated if either side's window had a foreign CPU load above 2.0 cores, a foreign GPU process, or (locked) a busy sample at other clocks

audit.rule: a round is flagged when the 1-minute load average exceeds 16.0 or procs_blocked exceeds 4 at the start or end of either side, or a foreign compute process was on the timed GPU; a flagged reading is taken again (ADR 0056)

500k.what: the A/B readings of dyng-compat-dynlp against LabelPropagation-CUDA@a276a3a (AD2, AD3): update[sum] and end_to_end on damped (gated), in_place reported
